configuration: the upstream ctest entry hoctests::test_eion_cover_py: run the shipped ion-coverage test under a thin wrapper that executes it unchanged (runpy, as the main module, so its internal assertions still gate the exit status) and then recomputes the seven quantities the test asserts on (three nernst potentials, two ghk fluxes, and the initial ina under secondorder 2 and 0 on a fresh hh section), writing them to eion_values.txt
observable: seven recomputed ion quantities (nernst for ena, nai and nao; ghk at two voltages; first-step ina at secondorder 2 and 0), one per line in eion_values.txt
variant: identical to nominal, with reason: the shipped script constructs its whole model and inputs itself and seeds any random stream it uses, so no external initial condition reaches it; an identical copy is the only sensible variant and the tolerance is exercised by the altbuild floor
altbuild: an -O0 build of the same source: run.sh altbuild appends -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-O0 and -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-O0 to the same cmake flags and builds into its own cache entry; selfcheck runs the nominal inputs on it and measures this check's floor from the disagreement between the two builds

evidence.floor_how: measured at selfcheck: the largest per-value disagreement between the nominal run and the altbuild run (an -O0 build of the same source), recorded in self-validation.json and copied here at calibration

warrant: Upstream grades this hoctests entry by the process exit status alone; the run still computes real numeric results, so the honest strengthening is to grade those values pointwise while keeping the upstream process (and its internal assertions) intact. The band is achievable because every recomputed quantity is a closed-form evaluation or a single deterministic integration step; repeats agree bit for bit and the -O0 altbuild moves them only at the measured floor. It is discriminating because a real fault in the ion channel machinery (nernst, ghk, ion current initialization, secondorder stepping) moves these values far outside the band, where the upstream assertions would only catch coarse errors. The floor is measured against the declared -O0 altbuild at selfcheck.
